record_fields.original_match_id: nonempty source-group ID; halves, replays and alternate encodes stay together
record_fields.input_manifest_sha256: exact 64-character lowercase hexadecimal input manifest hash
record_fields.prediction_sha256: 64-character lowercase hexadecimal retained raw-output hash, or null with an explicit no-output failure
record_fields.failure_reason: null on ordinary answer/abstention; explicit cause on failure
record_fields.endpoint_eligible: boolean determined by frozen criteria; exclusion reason required when false
record_fields.field_evidence_required: boolean fixed by endpoint/query contract before evaluation
record_fields.field_calibration_valid: boolean or null when unresolved/not applicable
record_fields.answer_correct: boolean or null pending independent labels and eligibility
record_fields.temporal_grounding_correct: boolean or null pending independent labels and eligibility
record_fields.field_grounding_correct: boolean or null pending independent labels/valid calibration or when not applicable

validation_rules: Retain every requested item and all attempt records; exactly one final outcome per requested item and comparison arm.
Missing provenance, invalid hashes, duplicate final rows and altered sealed inputs fail validation; record the failure without inventing missing metadata.
Primary denominator is all preregistered endpoint-eligible human-answerable requests. Model abstention, timeout, malformed output or validation failure cannot count as primary success.

Primary success requires an answered request with answer_correct=true and temporal_grounding_correct=true; when field evidence is required, field_calibration_valid=true and field_grounding_correct=true are also required.
Unresolved human labels or eligibility prevent scored scientific reporting. An unanswerable item is distinct from a model that did not answer.
Field-unobservable items and not-applicable dimensions must follow predeclared eligibility rules. Do not silently remove a method's invalid field evidence from its denominator.

Report requested, eligible, human-answerable, unanswerable, unresolved, answered, abstained, failure and exclusion counts with reasons and independent match counts; do not invent numeric values in this design artifact.
For each declared evaluated cohort, coverage is answered/eligible requests; selective risk is errors/answered requests. State the cohort and answer-only versus joint-grounded error definition.
With zero answered items, selective risk is undefined and coverage is zero; this is not perfect performance. With zero eligible items, coverage is undefined.
Correctness remains null when independent labels or an applicable observable dimension are absent. Model-written positive correctness is not evidence.
verification_boundary: This is an unscored field/rule contract, not an executable validator or observed experiment. Rejection cases describe expected behavior; no tests or model runs are claimed.
